{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''We Energies Rochester Lateral''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://psc.wi.gov/Pages/CommissionActions/CasePages/RochesterLateral.aspx|title=psc.wi.gov|website=psc.wi.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from Bluff Creek LNG Facility, Wisconsin to Oak Creek and Elm Road Generating Station campus, Oak Creek, Wisconsin.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://psc.wi.gov/Pages/CommissionActions/CasePages/RochesterLateral.aspx|title=psc.wi.gov|website=psc.wi.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
